operations.summary: reco.scan.destriper/1, a development binding, not native: conjugate gradient on the reduced destriping system restricted to the zero-sum subspace of the baselines, then the map by binning; writes destriper-product/1 with the embedded reconstruction:scan-v1 global product; --constraint zero-sum (default) or none (every parameter named unidentifiable, only determined combinations reported)

inputs.name: timestream
inputs.constraint: a destriper-timestream/1 file, role reconstruction-input: per sample an integer pixel index and a finite value, whole baselines of baseline_length samples, exactly the format's keys

inputs.name: product
inputs.constraint: the destriper-product/1 to write; never an existing file

inputs.name: stopping
inputs.constraint: relative recomputed residual at which the iteration stops, in (0, 1); default 1e-10

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.constraint: iteration budget, at least 1; default 10 per baseline

failure_states.meaning: the map is not determined by the data and the one constraint: an unobserved pixel, or more than one connected component (the components are listed); status not-converged when the budget ran out; no product is written
an input is refused (missing, malformed, an existing target, a stopping value outside (0, 1)); stdout carries status rejected and the reason; no product is written
numpy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran

operations.summary: Read a destriper-product/1 back, refusing a malformed or incomplete one or one whose method card differs, and run contracts.reconstruction.read_sidecar on the embedded reconstruction-product/1

failure_states.meaning: contracts.reconstruction refuses the embedded product; its error codes are listed
the product is missing, malformed or incomplete, or its method card differs; stdout carries status rejected
numpy is missing: stdout carries status missing-dependency, nothing ran
